# Silent exception handler census (f-29)

Generated 2026-09-28 23:38 UTC by `_f29_silent_pass_scan.py` (Python 3.11.15 ast walk).

## Definition

A hit is any `except` handler whose body consists only of `pass`
statements: `except: pass`, `except Exception: pass`,
`except SomeError: pass`, single-line or multi-line. A pass-only body
contains no logging call, no re-raise, no handling of any kind, so
every hit is by construction a handler without logging. Comments after
`pass` do not change the shape (comments are not statements).
